subject: Voice of customer session - discovery interview scheduling
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Nguyen <sofia.nguyen@mediwell.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Voice of customer session - discovery interview scheduling

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for agreeing to speak with us about MediWell's deployment of the Redwood platform — we really appreciate the time. We'd like to run a 45-minute discovery interview so we can capture the key themes for a short case study and quote. Typical structure: 10m context, 25m deep-dive (architecture, outcomes, metrics), 10m permissions/next steps.

Would any of these slots work for you and your team next week?
- Mon, Nov 16 — 10:00am-10:45am PT
- Tue, Nov 17 — 2:30pm-3:15pm PT
- Wed, Nov 18 — 11:00am-11:45am PT

Please let us know preferred time and who from MediWell will join (we usually invite product/ops and one technical stakeholder). We also record these sessions for internal notes and to extract short audio/video clips for the case study — I included a draft agenda and our media release/consent form for your legal team to glance at. If recording is an issue, happy to take detailed notes instead.

Attachments: redwood_case_study_draft_agenda.pdf, media_release_consent_form.docx

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0191
From: Sofia Nguyen <sofia.nguyen@mediwell.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Voice of customer session - discovery interview scheduling

Hi Neha,

Thanks — happy to help. We can do Tue, Nov 17 2:30pm-3:15pm PT. Attendees from MediWell will be me (Head of Customer Success) and Lucas Ward (Engineering lead on the integration).

Recording is fine for internal notes; two quick asks from our side: 1) please flag any sections that might reference HIPAA-adjacent operational details (we'll redact if needed), and 2) we need the final release form signed by MediWell's legal before publishing any clips. Your consent form looks standard but I will route it.

Also could you share a short agenda bullet list (so I can prep Lucas)?

Best,
Sofia

If neither can, Rishi — can you provide a 5-slide summary we can share at the top?

- 2:30-2:35pm — Intros & purpose
- 2:35-2:45pm — Business outcomes & metrics (Sofia)
- 2:45-3:00pm — Technical integration & performance (engineering lead + Rishi)
- 3:00-3:10pm — Results, ROI, metrics we can share
- 3:10-3:15pm — Permissions, next steps, signing the release
